title: pandas: groupby, split, apply, combine
source:
import pandas as pd

farm = pd.read_csv("farm.csv")
by_region = farm.groupby("region")
totals = by_region["yield_kg"].sum()
crop_stats = farm.groupby("crop").agg({"yield_kg": "mean", "rainfall_mm": "max"})
counts = farm.groupby("crop").size()

steps.narration: Read the CSV file "farm.csv" into a new DataFrame farm: 30 rows × 6 columns, one row per line of data and one column per header name.
Split the 30 rows of farm into 4 groups by region: Coast (7 rows), Highland (8), Lakeside (7) and Valley (8).
Grouped farm by region: split, apply, combine.
Grouped farm by crop: split, apply, combine.
Grouped farm by crop: split, apply, combine.
